errors.text_span: on an A100 80GB GPU for LLaMA 2-13B and 70B models
errors.evidence: This information is taken from the paper's caption, not the visual content of the figure itself. It's external context rather than a description of the plot.
The data points on the x-axis start before 20%, at approximately 10%. Stating the range is from 20% to 100% is incorrect.
For the orange line (Perplexity), the value at a 20% ratio is approximately 4.45, not 4.6. The starting value of approximately 4.6 corresponds to a ratio of about 10%.
The orange line (Perplexity) reaches its minimum value of approximately 4.3 at a 40% ratio, not an 80% ratio. At 80%, the value is higher, around 4.33.
The perplexity value at a 100% ratio is visibly below 4.4, at approximately 4.38.

errors.text_span: remains flat at approximately 42% from 20% to 80% ratio
errors.evidence: The blue line (GPU Mem. Ratio) does not remain flat. It shows a clear and steady increase from approximately 42% at a 20% ratio to about 55% at an 80% ratio.

errors.text_span: a red dashed line labeled "Full Cache PPL" that is constant at 4.35 across all ratios
errors.evidence: The red dashed line is located visibly closer to 4.4 than 4.3, at approximately 4.38. The value 4.35 is an inaccurate reading.
